title: Missouri university employee keeps $631,000 discrimination award; retrial ordered
summary_full: In a recent ruling, a Missouri court confirmed the jury's conclusion that Lincoln University established a racially hostile work setting for Sheila Gassner. The court did, however, nullify the damages linked to her constructive discharge claim and called for a new trial. Gassner, who endured heavy workloads while overseeing various departments, encountered discrimination after she raised issues.
